# nah_subnet (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_subnet" "app" {
  project    = "my-app"
  network_id = "NETWORK_ID"
  id         = "SUBNET_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `network_id` (String) Opaque parent network ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) Private IPv4 CIDR.
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
